## Define helpers

### File loading

```{r}

basePath <- "../Processed"

fileList <- list.files(basePath, pattern = "^Nico.*\\.rds$")

loadFile <- function(fileList, session, player, roundNum, model="DDAMFN_Aff7") {
  
  padded <- ifelse(roundNum < 10, paste0("0", roundNum), roundNum)
  
  pattern <- paste0("S", session, "_", player, "_R", padded)
  
  fileName <- grep(pattern, fileList, value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(fileName) == 0) {
    cat(
      "Error, no file for ", pattern, "\n\n"
    )
    return(NA)
  }
  
  file <- readRDS(file.path(basePath, fileName))
  
  df <- as.data.frame(file[[model]])
  
  names(df) <- modelMap[[model]]
  
  timestamps <- file[["timestamps"]]
  
  timestampsLngth <- length(timestamps)
  
  dfLgth <- nrow(df)
  
  if (timestampsLngth != dfLgth) {
    cat(
      "Error in file ", fileName, "\n\n",
      "Timestamps length: ", timestampsLngth, "\n\n",
      "Inference length: ", dfLgth, "\n\n"
    )
    df$timestamps <- NA
  } else {
    if (session <= 21) {
      df$timestamps <- timestamps - 7
    } else {
      df$timestamps <- timestamps
    }
  }
  
  cat(
    fileName, "\n\n",
    "Session match: ", file[["session"]] == session,
    ", Player match: ", file[["player"]] == player,
    ", Round match: ", file[["round"]] == roundNum, 
    "\n\n"
  )
  
  return(df)
}
```

### Series smoothing

```{r}

funEMA <- function(signal, ts, tau) {
  
  EMA <- numeric(length(signal))
  EMA[1] <- signal[1]
  
  for (i in 2:length(signal)) {
    dt <- ts[i] - ts[i - 1]
    alpha <- 1 - exp(-dt / tau)
    
    EMA[i] <- EMA[i - 1] +
      alpha * (signal[i] - EMA[i - 1])
  }
  
  EMA
}

smoothTs <- function(df, session, player, opponent, dyadID, roundNum, roundTime, agreement, signalName, modelName, halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25) {
  
  ts <- df$timestamps
  
  H <- halfLife # Half-life
  tau <- H / log(2)
  
  seriesNorm <- unname(sqrt(rowSums((df[, signalName, drop=FALSE])^2)))
    
  EMA <- funEMA(seriesNorm, ts, tau)

  roundStart <- 0
  startTimes <- seq(roundStart, roundTime, by=riskWindow)
  startTimes <- startTimes[startTimes < roundTime]
  endTimes <- c(startTimes[-1], roundTime)
  sampledEMA <- c()
  
  for (t in startTimes) {
    
    leftCandidates <- ts[ts <= t]
    rightCandidates <- ts[ts > t]
    
    if (length(leftCandidates) == 0) {
      
      sampledEMA <- c(sampledEMA, NA)
      
    } else {
      
      leftLimit <- max(leftCandidates)
      
      if (t - leftLimit > H) {
        
        sampledEMA <- c(sampledEMA, NA)
        
      } else if (length(rightCandidates) == 0) {
        
        leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
        sampledEMA <- c(sampledEMA, leftEMA)
        
      } else {
        
        rightLimit <- min(rightCandidates)
        
        if (rightLimit - t > H) {
          
          leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          sampledEMA <- c(sampledEMA, leftEMA)
          
        } else {
          
          weight <- (rightLimit - t) / (rightLimit - leftLimit)
          
          leftEMA <- EMA[match(leftLimit, ts)]
          rightEMA <- EMA[match(rightLimit, ts)]
          
          weightedEMA <- weight * leftEMA + (1 - weight) * rightEMA
          
          sampledEMA <- c(sampledEMA, weightedEMA)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  result <- tibble(
    session = session,
    player = player,
    opponent = opponent,
    dyadID = dyadID,
    round = roundNum,
    model = modelName,
    signal = paste(signalName, collapse="_"),
    valueEMA = sampledEMA,
    startTime = startTimes,
    endTime = endTimes,
    agreement = as.integer(
      agreement == 1 &
        seq_along(startTimes) == length(startTimes)
    )
  )
  
}
```

## Build smile long

```{r}

signalLongFun <- function(i, data, session, player, roundNum, roundTime, agreement, signalName, modelName, halfLife=2, riskWindow=0.25, startTs) {
        
  session     <- data[i, "session", drop = TRUE]
  player      <- data[i, "player", drop = TRUE]
  opponent    <- data[i, "opponent", drop = TRUE]
  dyadID      <- data[i, "dyadID", drop = TRUE]
  roundNum    <- data[i, "round", drop = TRUE]
  roundTime   <- data[i, "roundTime", drop = TRUE]
  agreement   <- data[i, "agreement", drop = TRUE]
  clockOffset <- data[i, "medianClockOffset", drop = TRUE]
  
  df <- loadFile(
    fileList,
    session=session,
    player=player,
    roundNum=roundNum,
    model=modelName
  )
  
  if (!is.data.frame(df)) {
    # file is NA
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0L || all(is.na(df$timestamps))) {
    # all NA entries
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  dyadKey <- as.character(dyadID)
  
  if (!dyadKey %in% names(startTs)) {
    warning(
      "No startTs entry for dyadID=", dyadKey,
      "; session=", session,
      "; player=", player,
      "; round=", roundNum
    )
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  startTime <- startTs[[dyadKey]]
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(timestamps = timestamps + clockOffset) %>%
    dplyr::filter(timestamps >= startTime)
  
  out <- smoothTs(
    df,
    session,
    player,
    opponent,
    dyadID,
    roundNum,
    roundTime,
    agreement,
    signalName,
    modelName,
    halfLife,
    riskWindow
  )
  
  return(out) # Success
}
```

```{r}

modelName <- "FERAU"
signalName <- c("Happy")
halfLife <- 2
riskWindow <- 0.25

storedDTW <- readRDS("../Datasets/dtwResults.rds")

startTs <- sapply(
  storedDTW[[1]],
  function(dyad) {
    start <- dyad$aligned[[1]]$pathTimestamps[[1]]
    names(start) <- dyad$dyadID
    return(start)
  }
)

rm(storedDTW)

dataSignalLong <- pbmclapply(
  1:nrow(dataF2F),
  signalLongFun,
  dataF2F, 
  session, 
  player, 
  roundNum, 
  roundTime, 
  agreement, 
  signalName, 
  modelName, 
  halfLife, 
  riskWindow, 
  startTs,
  mc.cores = 4
)

dataSignalLong <- do.call(
  rbind,
  dataSignalLong
)

opponentDf <- dataSignalLong %>%
  select(-opponent) %>%
  rename(
    opponentEMA=valueEMA
  )

by <- join_by(session, opponent==player, dyadID, round, model, signal, startTime, endTime, agreement)

dataSignalLong <- left_join(dataSignalLong, opponentDf, by=by)

rm(opponentDf)

resultsPath <- "../Datasets/dataSignalsLong.rds"

if (file.exists(resultsPath)) {
  storedResults <- readRDS(resultsPath) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(model == modelName & signal == paste(signalName, collapse = "_")))
} else {
  storedResults <- NULL
}

storedResults <- dplyr::bind_rows(storedResults, dataSignalLong)

saveRDS(storedResults, file = resultsPath)
```

## Build smile summary

```{r}

signalSummaryFun <- function(i, data, session, player, roundNum, roundTime, signalName, modelName, startTs, epsilon = 0.5) {
  
  session     <- data[i, "session", drop = TRUE]
  player      <- data[i, "player", drop = TRUE]
  opponent    <- data[i, "opponent", drop = TRUE]
  dyadID      <- data[i, "dyadID", drop = TRUE]
  roundNum    <- data[i, "round", drop = TRUE]
  roundTime   <- data[i, "roundTime", drop = TRUE]
  clockOffset <- data[i, "medianClockOffset", drop = TRUE]
  
  df <- loadFile(
    fileList,
    session=session,
    player=player,
    roundNum=roundNum,
    model=modelName
  )
  
  if (!is.data.frame(df)) {
    # file is NA
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  if (nrow(df) == 0L || all(is.na(df$timestamps))) {
    # all NA entries
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  dyadKey <- as.character(dyadID)
  
  if (!dyadKey %in% names(startTs)) {
    warning(
      "No startTs entry for dyadID=", dyadKey,
      "; session=", session,
      "; player=", player,
      "; round=", roundNum
    )
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  startTime <- startTs[[dyadKey]]
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(timestamps = timestamps + clockOffset) %>%
    dplyr::filter(startTime <= timestamps & timestamps <= roundTime + epsilon)
  
  signalSummary <- mean(sqrt(rowSums((df[, signalName, drop=FALSE])^2)), na.rm=TRUE)
    
  out <- tibble(
    session = session,
    player = player,
    opponent = opponent,
    dyadID = dyadID,
    round = roundNum,
    model = modelName,
    signal = paste(signalName, collapse="_"),
    value = signalSummary
  )
  
  return(out) # Success
}
```

```{r}

modelName <- "FERAU"
signalName <- "Happy"

storedDTW <- readRDS("../Datasets/dtwResults.rds")

startTs <- sapply(
  storedDTW[[1]],
  function(dyad) {
    start <- dyad$aligned[[1]]$pathTimestamps[[1]]
    names(start) <- dyad$dyadID
    return(start)
  }
)

rm(storedDTW)

dataSignalSummary <- pbmclapply(
  1:nrow(dataF2F),
  signalSummaryFun,
  dataF2F, 
  session, 
  player, 
  roundNum, 
  roundTime, 
  signalName, 
  modelName, 
  startTs,
  epsilon=0.5,
  mc.cores = 4
)

dataSignalSummary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  dataSignalSummary
)

opponentDf <- dataSignalSummary %>%
  select(-opponent) %>%
  rename(
    opponentValue=value
  )

by <- join_by(session, opponent==player, dyadID, round, model, signal)

dataSignalSummary <- left_join(dataSignalSummary, opponentDf, by=by)

rm(opponentDf)


resultsPath <- "../Datasets/dataSignals.rds"

if (file.exists(resultsPath)) {
  storedResults <- readRDS(resultsPath) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!(model == modelName & signal == paste(signalName, collapse = "_")))
} else {
  storedResults <- NULL
}

storedResults <- dplyr::bind_rows(storedResults, dataSignalSummary)

saveRDS(storedResults, file = resultsPath)
```

```{r}

ggplot(data = smilePlotDf, aes(x=timeToAgreement, y=anger))+
  geom_jitter(color="steelblue", alpha=0.05)+
  geom_smooth(color="steelblue", fill="steelblue", linewidth=1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-3, 70)) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(data = smilePlotDf, aes(x=time, y=anger))+
  geom_jitter(color="lightcoral", alpha=0.05)+
  geom_smooth(color="lightcoral", fill="lightcoral", linewidth=1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-10, 60)) +
  labs(
    title = "Smiling trajectory",
    x = "Round time",
    y = "Smiling"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
